timings.totals_note: Parent totals include child stages. Do not sum all keys; other includes cleanup, scheduling and instrumentation overhead. Optional or reused stages are zero.

parameters.overlap_area_geometry: actual text polygon intersected with current axis-aligned YOLO box
parameters.sector_rule: positive projection on selected axis and atan2(abs(perpendicular projection), forward projection) <= half angle; ALL uses union of four axes; closest available text wins once
